description: Form whose model is built by directives in the template (`ngModel`, `ngForm`). Angular creates the `FormControl`s for you.
Directive automatically attached to `<form>` by `FormsModule`. Exposes `value`, `valid`, `invalid`, `submitted`, `resetForm()`.
Registers a control under its `name` attribute and syncs it with a property or signal through `[(ngModel)]`.
`touched` becomes true after blur; `dirty` after the user changes the value. Use them to avoid showing errors too early.
`required`, `minlength`, `maxlength`, `pattern`, `email`, `min`, `max` attributes add validators to the control.
Event emitted by `NgForm` on submit. Unlike `(submit)`, it marks the form as submitted.
